title: Ancestral Bond
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|Ancestral Bond}}

'''Ancestral Bond''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] that raises the active [[totem]] limit by one. As a drawback, the character cannot deal [[damage]] directly. 

==Mechanics==

With Ancestral Bond, damage may only be dealt through indirect means such as [[proxies]], [[minion]]s, and sources unaffected by offensive damage modifiers like [[reflect]], {{psl|Master Toxicist}}, or {{il|Flame Surge}}'s burning ground. Despite specifying 'with [[skills]]', this effect is not limited to skills, and will prevent damage by the character's non-skill [[explosion]]s.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tpiscAcc-5U</ref> It does not prevent [[self-damage]]. 

While Ancestral Bond prevents damage and effects that require damage, it does not prevent [[hits]] or [[critical strikes]]. Effects like {{il|Culling Strike Support}} or {{il|Power Charge On Critical Support}} may be used normally. 

==Location==
Ancestral Bond lies on the outer northwest side of the tree, between Templar and Witch, near the [[Primal Manifestation]] totem cluster.
